translations.en: Not that, but the meaning of this mission.
A princess, fourth in line, missing for 18 years.
Even if found, she'd be useless for political marriage.
I think...
You... This mission is to redeem war disgrace.
A vital mission entrusted to us by the Water Maiden.
Disgrace...
In Levia's homeland, as a guest commander,
a war erupted between Lewinia and a neighbor.
At that time, Levia's White Earth Dragon Knights and I
were about to hit the capital from a different flank,
fought the enemy's trump card, a giant demon,
and destroyed it despite heavy losses.
However, unlike those of us who actually fought the demon,
those who only saw its corpse, especially ignorant nobles,
that Levia, who lost many men, had poor command,
it was said...
Due to wounds from that battle I lost much power,
I was unable to fight in later battles,
and was dismissed as completely useless.
The only one who fairly judged our deeds was
the great guardian god of Lewinia and my ally,
the Water Maiden alone.
Enshrined as a living god deep in the palace,
gave us this mission as an oracle to let us recover
and got us out of the postwar chaos at home.
But it seems that didn't get through to Levia,
and she's overly eager.
Even the rumor behind this mission,
that a princess missing 18 years was seen here,
is a dubious rumor.
Even if those nobles don't acknowledge it,
we alone defeated a monster that matched an army,
that's hardly a disgrace worth redeeming.
You're the one who killed that monster.
I couldn't have done it alone.
Shut up! You're the one who finished it.
I... I let my soldiers die in vain...
Levia... the lives lost in battle
calling them wasted doesn't sit well with me.
Ah... sorry, forget what I just said.
Yeah.
Embarrassed by her own words, her anger faded,
Levia turned on her heel as if to hide her face.
